scope: UI-only ResourceTiming diagnostics on index.html and network-check.html; no live anonymity, proof-verification or wallet-transaction claim.

environment.privateContext: Chromium isolated browser context created with createBrowserContext
environment.warmCacheFixture: cacheable localhost JavaScript with Timing-Allow-Origin; server request counter and ResourceTiming transfer size observed

transportIsolation.method: Intercept the anon-transport.ts module in memory and replace startAnonTransport with a rejected UI stub. No repository transport source was edited.
transportIsolation.workerStatus: Every case asserted Transport disabled for UI QA in the worker status.
transportIsolation.httpInterception: Non-loopback HTTP(S) requests were aborted during page startup. Interception was disabled for the local cache fixture after the failed stub status appeared.
transportIsolation.webRtc: Not measured by ResourceTiming or this HTTP interceptor. The actual anonymous transport was replaced in these UI cases; no assertion of complete browser network visibility is made.

checks.warmCacheOutcome: Both pages retained observations in normal and private contexts, including a cached localhost load with zero transferred bytes. Clearing ResourceTiming did not erase retained observations.
checks.unavailableTimingOutcome: Both pages rendered warning-class status and explanatory table rows when PerformanceObserver and performance.getEntriesByType were injected as unavailable. This simulates unavailable APIs; it does not claim every private browser hides timings.
checks.cachedExecutionLimit: Multiple uses of the cached script exposed one resource timing entry in this browser. The UI counts observed entries, not script executions or network connections.

reproducer.requirements: Installed Puppeteer Core and Chromium, frontend Vite on localhost:5207, free localhost:5208 for the cache fixture. Transport module interception is required to isolate these UI checks from gateway startup.

limitations: Development pages only, not a new production release or public gateway test.
No live Tor exit, WebRTC, ENS directory, verified read or wallet transaction was validated.
Private-context coverage is Chromium only; unsupported APIs were additionally simulated.
Observed entries do not prove the absence of direct RPC and are bounded to 512 per page.
